cases.name: streaming reveal, expiry, and zero frames after expiry
unchanged cells never appear and never schedule
typewriter stagger, pending concealment, expiry at last stamp + duration
persistent burst schedules adjacent rebuilds in reading order
sustained output never grows the animation window past max_ahead
cursor trail linear 250ms fade with three shape-aware echoes
unfocused trail draws nothing and resumes the fade on refocus
disabled effects retain nothing and schedule no frames
max_tracked_cells bounds the change store to the row-major prefix
bottom-up iCellMetrics: negative row step, flipped origin
